literal: Bright wealth to grow firm to those who have made, easy thing the other two also together.
translation: To those who have firmly accumulated excellent wealth, the other two goals of life are easy to attain together.
modern: சிறந்த பொருளை மிகுதியாகச் சேர்த்தவர்களுக்கு, மற்ற இரண்டுமாகிய அறமும் இன்பமும் எளிதில் ஒருசேரக் கிடைக்கும்.
explanation: The couplet states that acquiring wealth makes the other two goals of life, virtue and pleasure, easily attainable. 'ஒண்பொருள்' refers to excellent or rightfully earned wealth. 'காழ்ப்ப' means to grow firm or abundant, emphasizing the solid accumulation of this wealth. When wealth is secured, 'ஏனை இரண்டும்' (the other two) naturally follow 'ஒருங்கு' (together) without much difficulty.
